description: This file defines the ProjectActivityDao class, which provides data access methods for ProjectActivity entities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, checking existence, copying, and deleting project activities, as well as querying related data such as project and timesheet items.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for ProjectActivity entities, providing methods to retrieve, manipulate, and validate project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: getProjectActivityListByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProjectActivity entities associated with a specific project ID, filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for project activities based on project ID and search filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of project activities matching the specified filters.

methods.name: saveProjectActivity
methods.description: Persists a ProjectActivity entity to the database.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Project entity by its ID.

methods.name: getProjectActivityByProjectIdAndProjectActivityId
methods.description: Fetches a specific ProjectActivity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: getExistingProjectActivityIdsForProject
methods.description: Checks for existing activity IDs within a project to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: hasActivityGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks if a project activity has associated timesheet items.

methods.name: deleteProjectActivities
methods.description: Marks specified project activities as deleted after verifying they have no associated timesheet items.

methods.name: isProjectActivityNameTaken
methods.description: Validates whether a project activity name is already taken within a project, excluding the current activity if updating.

methods.name: getDuplicatedActivities
methods.description: Finds activities with duplicate names across projects for potential duplication detection.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesByActivityIds
methods.description: Retrieves ProjectActivity entities for a list of activity IDs.

methods.name: copyActivities
methods.description: Copies activities from one project to another by creating new entities.

methods.name: getActivitiesCountByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Counts activities based on pairs of activity and project IDs.

methods.name: getActivitiesPaginatorByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Builds a paginator for activities filtered by pairs of IDs.
